page: Alibaba Cloud ecs.sn1.3xlarge is an x86_64 architecture server powered by an Intel Xeon 8269CY processor running at 2.5 GHz. It features 16 dedicated vCPUs mapped to 8 physical cores with hyper-threading enabled. The system is equipped with 32.0 GB of system memory, providing a resource density of 2.0 GB per core. It does not include local storage or dedicated GPU hardware, relying on network-attached storage and a baseline network bandwidth of 3 Gbps.

Benchmark data indicates a clear contrast between single-core and multi-core performance. Single-core execution, such as stress-ng single-core CPU and Geekbench single-core tests, falls into the weak and poor categories, respectively. Single-threaded compression tasks also show lower efficiency. However, multi-core performance, including Geekbench multi-core, Passmark CPU, and multi-threaded bzip3 decompression, reaches average tiers. Memory bandwidth tests for both cached and uncached reads and writes also perform within the average range, though Passmark memory scores are relatively weak.

Given the 1:2 vCPU-to-RAM ratio, this instance is structured as a compute-optimized resource. The qualitative cost efficiency is characterized by dedicated CPU allocation, though the older Intel Xeon architecture results in lower single-threaded performance per resource unit. It is best suited for multi-threaded workloads that can leverage all 16 vCPUs, such as static web serving, multi-threaded data decompression, Redis database operations, and moderate parallel compilation tasks, rather than single-threaded or memory-intensive applications.
